name: KernelPatch KPM runtime
purpose: ApkeSU GKI Native KPM early-boot runtime and kptools image patcher

local_hardening: strict sukisu_kpm_* hook argument counts and fail-closed readiness
bounded KPM list/info output with balanced RCU unlocks
ELF, file-size and kstorage bounds retained across the 0.13.9 update
serialized module publication/removal and per-call control arguments retained
unrelated upstream SELinux hide/policy sources excluded from the KPM-only build
upstream task-hook filesystem debug writer disabled in production
NDK clang map compiled with -Oz while preserving the 4 KiB linker bound
callback values checked after relocation; unresolved imports return ENOLINK
import_policy.preset_sync: tools/preset.h is copied from kernel/include/preset.h so the host patcher uses the same map layout as kpimg

runtime_contract.target: AArch64 Android GKI boot kernel Image
runtime_contract.entry_flow: kptools patches the kernel entry; kpimg resolves early kernel symbols, hooks the ApkeSU Native KPM ABI, then returns to the original entry
runtime_contract.lkm_mode: not used; LKM continues to use the existing KPatch-Next path
